answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 12666 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to recite the duas before and after and the niyyahs for wudhu and ghusl in the bathroom? If not, where should they be recited? Question: Is it permissible to recite the duas before and after and the niyyahs for wudhu and ghusl in the bathroom? If not, where should they be recited? Answer ID: 12666 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 808/607=L/1430) If the bathroom is attached and there is not much distance between toilet and bathroom, so the dua should not be recited, rather the dua in the beginning and end of wudhu should be recited before entering and after going out respectively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
